The earlier answer holds up. I re-derived it independently and got the same unique schedule.

- Ann is right after Ben, and Elif is right after Cara, so Cara is at B+2 and Elif at B+3. "Exactly one between Ann and Elif" then fixes Ann at B+1 and Elif at B+3.
- Elif must come before Dev, so Elif ≤ 8 and Ben ≤ 5. Ben also has four people before him (Finn, Hana, Gus, Ivo), so Ben ≥ 5. That makes Ben = 5.
- Ann = 6, Cara = 7, Elif = 8, and Dev = 9.
- Slots 1–4 hold Finn, Hana, Gus and Ivo. Ann–Hana ≥ 3 forces Hana ≤ 3, and Hana = Ivo + 1 with Finn < Hana forces Finn = 1, Ivo = 2, Hana = 3, Gus = 4.

All 17 constraints check out. The shared note's "Ben in slot 4" option is impossible, since four people (Finn, Hana, Gus, Ivo) must all come before Ben.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Finn","2":"Ivo","3":"Hana","4":"Gus","5":"Ben","6":"Ann","7":"Cara","8":"Elif","9":"Dev"}
CONFIDENCE: 99
